overview:
## About BOSS Battle

Bitshala builds and teaches Bitcoin Open Source Software — that's the "BOSS" in our name, and also the joke behind this one. Between cohort-based learning on Bitcoin's protocol and privacy stack, and the invite-only BOSS Summit that gathers India's sharpest Bitcoin OSS builders twice a year, we've mostly kept things small and deep. BOSS Battle flips that: it's virtual, it's open, and it's a hackathon instead of a summit.

Three boss fights this round:

- **Privacy** — build tools that make Bitcoin harder to surveil and easier to use without leaking who you are.
- **Nostr** — build on the protocol rewriting what censorship-resistant identity and communication look like.
- **AI** — bring AI into the Bitcoin/Nostr stack: agents, tooling, automation — whatever pushes it forward.

You don't need a GitHub history full of BIPs to show up. Beginners get workshops, mentors, and a community that answers questions instead of gatekeeping them. Experienced builders get a chance to finally prototype the thing they've been meaning to build, surrounded by people who actually get it.

No stage, no suits — just your terminal and three boss fights between you and the leaderboard.

**Ship code. Beat the boss.**

# ⚡ Hefty Hacks

**Hefty Hacks** is a fully-online **Finance × Trading** hackathon presented by **TechZap**. Over one intense sprint, engineers, quants and designers turn market chaos into working product — trading systems, market predictors, fintech, risk engines, DeFi and everything in between.

Pick a niche. Go absurdly deep. Ship something the street hasn't seen yet.

> 🌟 **Exclusive Career Opportunity**: The **Top 10 teams** will get a chance to participate in direct hiring rounds with leading companies and fast-growing startups. 
> 
> *(Selection for interviews and hiring is solely at the discretion of the participating companies and subject to their individual eligibility criteria and recruitment policies.)*

> **Finance. Trading. Innovation.** — one laptop, a thesis worth defending, and 36 hours to prove it.

---

## 🚀 What is Hefty Hacks?

The markets never sleep, and neither do great builders. Hefty Hacks challenges you to build at the intersection of **finance and trading** — from high-frequency execution engines to market predictors, robo-advisors, fraud radars and on-chain quant tooling.

There's one rule that decides winners: **go narrow.** Anyone can build "a trading app." The teams that win pick a niche so specific it sounds obsessive — then own it.

- 🌐 **100% Online** — hack from anywhere in the world
- 👥 **Teams of 2–6** — no solo entries; finance is a team sport
- 🗓️ **Final Hack Day: 31 Oct – 1 Nov** — a 36-hour build sprint
- 🏆 **₹75,000 prize pool** + free Azure credits + elite mentorship

---

## 🎯 Tracks

Build on either track — or fuse them into something nobody has shipped yet.

### 01 · Finance
Reinvent how money moves, grows and stays safe — on-chain or off.
- Payments, lending & neo-banking
- Personal finance & wealth autopilot
- Fraud, AML & risk intelligence
- Insurance, credit scoring & RegTech
- **Decentralized finance (DeFi)** — on-chain lending, tokenization & protocols

### 02 · Trading
Turn market microstructure into a working edge.
- Algo, HFT & execution engines
- Futures, options & derivatives tooling
- Market prediction & alt-data signals
- Backtesting & portfolio optimization

### 03 · Fusion *(the boldest bets score highest)*
Combine both tracks into something genuinely unique.
- Sentiment-to-signal fintech apps
- On-chain quant & DeFi execution
- Embedded trading inside consumer finance
- Your own uncharted crossover

---

## 🤖 On Using AI

**Bring the idea. Let AI sharpen it.**

Generating your idea straight from an AI is **strongly discouraged** — judges can smell a generated pitch, and a borrowed thesis has no conviction behind it. Instead:

1. Pick a niche narrow enough to defend in one sentence.
2. Write your **own** thesis first — the bet nobody else is making.
3. Use AI to attack it: what breaks, what's been tried, what's missing.
4. Refine, prototype, and ship the version only your team could build.

**Your niche, AI's leverage.** Originality is the edge we score for.

---

## ⚖️ How We Judge

- **Originality of the niche** — how sharp and defensible is the bet?
- **Technical depth** — did you actually build the hard part?
- **Working demo** — does it run and hold up under questions?
- **Market insight** — do you understand the problem you're solving?

A sharp, unique idea executed well beats a broad idea half-built.

---

Hefty Hacks is built and run by **TechZap** — bringing builders together to disrupt finance.

**Build. Innovate. Disrupt.**

# **FusioniX 2026**
**Overview**

FusioniX 2026 is a 24-hour national-level hybrid Offline hackathon organized by the Department of Electronics & Communication Engineering and the Department of Computer Science & Engineering (IoT), University of Engineering and Management, Kolkata.

FusioniX focuses on solving real-world engineering challenges by combining hardware and software to build innovative, practical working prototypes.

Whether you're passionate about IoT, AI, Embedded Systems, Robotics, Full Stack, Cloud, Computer Vision, Smart Automation, Web3, or Agentic Commerce, FusioniX is your platform to build and innovate.

Please use this Template: [Download](https://www.canva.com/design/DAHSKhhyp4Y/wcuf7vO6wiiPgsLOQtCqPw/edit)
**🏆Prize Pool: ₹30,000+**

Win exciting prizes worth up to ₹50,000.

Along with prizes, participants get certificates, recognition, goodies & swags, networking opportunities with mentors and industry experts, and a chance to showcase their solutions.



**Team Size**

3–4 members per team

Registration is free.
Inter-college teams are allowed.




**Event**

Duration: 24 Hours
Round 1: Online
Final Hackathon (Rounds 2 & 3): Offline at UEM Kolkata


**Eligibility**

Open to students pursuing:

B.Tech / B.E.
M.Tech / M.E.
Engineering or Technology programs from recognized institutions

Students from any engineering specialization can participate.



**Tracks**
Sub Track 1 — x402-Powered Applications

Build applications powered by x402, exploring programmable payments, automated transactions, and digital commerce.

Sub Track 2 — Agentic Commerce Infrastructure

Build infrastructure enabling AI agents to discover, negotiate, transact, and operate autonomously in digital commerce.

Sub Track 3 — Developer Tooling & Frameworks

Create developer tools, SDKs, libraries, frameworks, APIs, or platforms that improve the software development experience.

Sub Track 4 — Biotech

Build technology-driven solutions at the intersection of biology and innovation. Explore AI, computational biology, bioinformatics, healthcare, agriculture, lab automation, and other applications that use technology to address real-world challenges in life sciences .

Sub Track 5 —  AI for Real-World Impact

Build innovative AI-powered solutions that address meaningful real-world problems. From education and sustainability to accessibility, finance, agriculture, cybersecurity, and smart communities, use AI to create practical solutions with measurable impact.

Sub Track 6 — Open Source

Build impactful open-source solutions that encourage collaboration, transparency, and community-driven development. Create tools, platforms, libraries, or applications that others can use, extend, and contribute to.


**Competition Format**
Round 1 — Concept Qualifier (Online)

Submit a minimum 5-slide Pitch Deck (PPT/PDF) covering:
PPt format: https://canva.link/uhjmqki7duf082q
Team Introduction
Problem Analysis
Proposed Solution
Hardware & Software Architecture
Technology Stack

Evaluation: Problem Understanding, Technical Feasibility, Innovation, and Clarity of Presentation.

⚠️ **Important**: The Round 1 idea is only for evaluation. Qualified teams will receive entirely new problem statements during the offline hackathon.

**Round 2 — Hybrid Build & Final Offline Round**

Teams will work on their complete solution by assembling hardware, developing software, designing the system architecture, integrating components, testing, debugging, and preparing a working prototype.

As this is a hybrid competition, teams may use hardware, software, or a combination of both according to their project requirements.

Participants should bring their own hardware whenever possible. Limited hardware support may be available.

Teams must complete and demonstrate their working solution during this round and submit the final source code, documentation, and required project deliverables before the deadline.

**🤖 AI Usage Policy**

AI tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Claude may be used for learning, brainstorming, debugging, documentation, and productivity.

However:

AI must not replace genuine problem-solving.
Blind copy-pasting without understanding is prohibited.
Primarily AI-generated or plagiarized projects will be disqualified.
Judges may ask technical questions to verify understanding.

Innovation and originality matter.


**📜 General Rules**
Major development must be done during the hackathon.
Teams must work independently.
Pre-built complete solutions are not allowed.
Bring your own laptops and hardware whenever possible.
Internet, workspace, power supply, meals, and accommodation (where applicable) will be provided.
Organizers may modify schedules if required.
Plagiarism or unfair means may lead to disqualification.
Judges' decisions will be final.


**🏅 Judging Criteria**

Projects will be evaluated on:

Innovation & Creativity • Technical Implementation • Functionality • Hardware–Software Integration • Market Potential • Scalability • Presentation & Demonstration • Teamwork

Hackrit  is a 24-hour offline hackathon designed to bring together developers, designers, and problem-solvers to build practical solutions from scratch.

Organized as part of DEVX by **Google Developer Group on Campus Techno India University**, the hackathon focuses on real-world problem solving through rapid prototyping and collaborative development. Participants work in teams, explore ideas across multiple domains, and transform them into functional products within a constrained timeframe.

Hackrit emphasizes execution over theory. It encourages participants to think critically, experiment with technologies, and deliver solutions that are not only innovative but also implementable.

Whether you are refining an idea or building something entirely new, Hackrit provides an environment to learn, collaborate, and create meaningful impact through technology.
